For all who were at the Community Call today, thanks for coming! Apologies for the long presentation length - In presenting, the part I was most looking forward to was feedback from you all. I am attaching my slides here and hope some of you might be interested in reaching out to talk more :slight_smile:

Contact me:
•Andrea Tentner @ Zulip
•andrea.tentner@rooteddata.org

Try the current/old version of the app here
Check out the in-progress refactor of the app here

dataverse-community-meeting.pptx

And here's the recording! And the notes.

I just posted these on the thread on the mailing list.

You used Gary's Replication Data for: Differentially Private Survey Research dataset in the demo. With files like k_sims.csv, fig2a.R, etc.

I'd be interested to see the files you produced with the tool.

Hi @Philip Durbin 🚀 , yes that's the dataset I used for the demo.

I will plan to share a full HEAL data package for this dataset later today on demo.dataverse.org. I will post the link here when it's available!
Sounds great. Also, thanks for clarifying that the version of the tool you demo'ed was the current/old version rather than the in-progress refactor. I was turned around about that! :sweat_smile:

Sorry for the confusion! For easy access for anyone else who may want to try out the version of the tool that I used for the demo yesterday, info for how to get it:

  • the version of the app that I used for the demo is the old version - for that version:

    • releases/downloadable executables can be downloaded from here
    • the code lives here
    • to build that tool for development call python dsc_pkg_tool.py
a HEAL data package for this dataset can be found here
Perfect, thanks! I'll also upload it here because datasets are deleted from that demo site periodically: dsc_pkg_tool_example.zip
